description: luismc-project-setup: SessionStart offers to apply the new project config when the luismc plugins have changed since the project was last set up (SO9). Opt-in by the project: nothing happens in a directory that turns on no luismc plugin. The hook only prints text; the stamp is written by the script on a yes or a no.

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/plugin_update_offer.py" hook; else python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/plugin_update_offer.py" hook; fi
